blogs.title: The Third Valve: Is TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV Feasible?
blogs.description: Explores the technical feasibility and 1-year outcomes of a third transcatheter aortic valve implantation. This post analyzes the expanding indications for TAVI as patient longevity increases, discussing the hemodynamic challenges and success of managing structural deterioration in multiple prosthetic layers.

blogs.title: TAVI After Endocarditis: Navigating the Infection Dilemma
blogs.description: Analyzes the controversial decision-making process for reintervening on a prosthetic valve after treated infective endocarditis. Weighs the risks of seeding infection against prohibitive surgical risk, highlighting the critical importance of confirming complete infection resolution before proceeding.

blogs.title: CT Planning for the 'Russian Doll' Aorta: Avoiding Coronary Obstruction
blogs.description: Details the critical role of multislice CT in complex valve-in-valve scenarios. Focuses on measuring coronary ostial height, sinus dimensions, and frame interactions to prevent catastrophic coronary occlusion during triple TAVI procedures.

blogs.title: Commissural Alignment: Technical Pearls for Redo TAVI
blogs.description: Breaks down the specific procedural techniques used to optimize hemodynamics in stacked valves. Discusses how high implantation and commissural alignment can preserve coronary access, reduce patient-prosthesis mismatch, and improve long-term valve function.

blogs.title: Lifetime Management: Planning for Future Valve Failure
blogs.description: Discusses the concept of 'lifetime management' in structural heart disease. Emphasizes the need for early consideration of future reinterventions when selecting the initial valve type and procedural strategy to avoid running out of options in younger or high-risk patients.

blogs.title: Beyond the Score: Risk Stratification in Prohibitive Surgery Cases
blogs.description: Examines the role of risk scores (like EuroSCORE II) and complex comorbidities in selecting TAVI over surgical explantation. Highlights how multidisciplinary heart team decisions guide therapy when open surgery is technically hazardous or medically contraindicated.
